sourceAdaptations: Use complete original Form HTML section, all original CSS and seven referenced SVG drawings. Original native input/radio/checkbox/select geometry and border-image CSS retained.

Original SVG bytes are percent-encoded text data URIs to keep CSS assets self-contained under existing img-src data CSP; not screenshots/covers, no base64 or binary packaging. XML reviewed only svg/path/g and no event/href attrs.
Remove external Short Stack font request, original cursive fallback retained with original example body font sizes/responsive breakpoint.
Correct original number/search label typos and duplicate check3 id/for. Password and file controls disabled visibly; do not collect credentials or files.

Original form has no backend or validation logic. Host adds local validity summary without echoing values, reset and harmless button feedback. Submit control becomes button to prevent form navigation; submit handler prevents implicit-submit navigation.

Form begins inert until all initialization/handlers installed. Startup or output failure disables/removes controls/listeners and renders unavailable. Hidden preserves native field state with CSS transitions off; exit is terminal and retained controls disabled.

dedup.difference: Original complete native form sheet uses handdrawn SVG border-image artwork; not Plop status/current-step or PaperCSS checkbox disclosure. Same broad handdrawn style, not claimed new category.
